Class UpgradeStationFXController

java.lang.Object
controller.UpgradeStationFXController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class UpgradeStationFXController extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
The UpgradeStationFXController class is responsible for managing the user interface and functionalities related to upgrading user-owned stations in the application. This includes displaying stations, managing available upgrades, handling budget updates, and processing user interactions to apply upgrades. The controller works in conjunction with JavaFX UI components, synchronizing data and operations to ensure a smooth user experience. It also interacts with data models such as the map, scenario, budget, and time period to provide accurate and contextual upgrade options. Responsibilities: - Displaying a list of user-owned stations and their details. - Calculating and displaying available building upgrades. - Checking budget availability and updating the budget post-upgrade. - Managing user interactions with the upgrade process. - Handling errors and providing feedback messages to the user.
